{{one source|date=December 2016}}

In [[probability theory]], '''Glivenko's theorem''' states that if <math>\varphi_n, n\in \mathbb N</math>, <math>\varphi</math> are the characteristic functions of some [[probability distribution]]s <math>\mu_n, \mu</math> respectively and <math>\varphi_n \to \varphi</math> almost everywhere, then <math>\mu_n \to \mu</math> in the sense of probability distributions.<ref name ="ito" />
